proposal.summary: Uzay Baskul Weighbridge Automation Software before 1.1 is affected by an SQL Injection vulnerability allowing injection into SQL commands.
proposal.cwe_quote: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability
proposal.recommended_next_step: Request or obtain a detailed vulnerability report or proof-of-concept from the reporter specifying affected endpoints, the injection vector, conditions for exploitation, and observed impacts; reproduce the issue to determine exact scope and produce patches or mitigation guidance (parameterized queries, input validation, least privilege DB account).

evidence_quotes.quote: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability
This issue affects Weighbridge Automation Software: before 1.1.

evidence_quotes.claim: Summary statement that SQL injection is allowed
